label: neiso 16 ct deploy
definition: neiso 16 (KEEPER): neiso 14 (Merrimack COAL_BIT, keeper offer curve) + the targeted ct_deployment AS/reserve overlay, now surviving the P2 commitment screen because min_gen is carried through it (a reserve floor must survive the *economic* screen). CT_PEAKER recovers its measured sub-marginal wedge: 0.014/0.014/0.038 -> 0.084/0.052/0.079 TWh (2023/24/25). Gas total unchanged (54.78/58.89/60.14, -1.2/-1.3/+0.1% vs EIA-930) and price level unchanged (34.9/40.2/70.5 vs actual DA 36.8/41.5/67.9) -- the CT energy displaces CC within gas, NOT coal/imports (the blanket-floor failure mode). CC_REGULAR offer curve held at keeper values (the re-derived Jacobian, neiso 15, shows CC bands cannot reach CT/ST). The residual CT/ST/oil gap is the non-offer-recoverable reserve / winter-data limit.
